items: Full Check, rebuilt: it moves you off a server that isn't answering, finds the real cause and shows what it saw, with a report to send your provider.
Now puts your country's competitions first, and Watch Live goes to your country's broadcaster.
On the match page, the stats sit under the score and long feed lists fold up.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
